decisions.reason: The source changes booking-system placement only and does not change the separate calendar or its location-specific Wix placement.
The existing master-site location routing remains valid unchanged; the source only excludes booking functionality from the main site.
The source addresses bookings but does not change where payments are processed or whether payment setups remain isolated.
Handling bookings on location websites does not alter the established separate payout and payment-account setup.
The source does not change separate revenue, sales, or reporting behavior for each location.
The source relies on the already-established location websites but does not modify the separate-website architecture.
The source does not discuss or change the requirement for each location to have its own Wix account.
The booking-placement decision neither changes Harbor Valley site availability during transition nor its existing master-site linkage.
Booking-system placement does not affect the visual layout, navigation reference, or shared design template.
The source does not change the master website domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
Locating bookings on related location websites does not change the expansion capability or reusable location-template strategy.
The source does not change package catalogs or pricing consistency across location websites.
